reviews.text:
Exceptional Service from Integra Lawns
I recently had the pleasure of working with Integra Lawns, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From start to finish, their team demonstrated professionalism, efficiency, and a genuine commitment to customer satisfaction. Here’s why I highly recommend them:
1.	Responsive and Efficient: Integra was the first company to respond to my inquiry, and they promptly scheduled a visit. Jeremy, their representative, listened attentively as we walked through my yard, discussing the necessary shrub and tree trimming.
2.	Clear Upfront Pricing: Within just two days, I received a fair estimate. Their pricing was competitive, and I appreciated their detailed breakdown for their pricing.
3.	Swift Action: To my surprise, Integra contacted me the very next day to begin the work. Their speed and dedication impressed me.
4.	Impeccable Workmanship: The results speak for themselves. My shrubs are now neatly squared up, and my trees look symmetrical again. The attention to detail was evident.
5.	Thorough Cleanup: Not only did they trim and shape the greenery, but they also left my yard spotless. Porch, driveway, and sidewalks—all debris-free!
6.	First-Time Satisfaction: As a first-time customer, I’m thrilled with the quality of service. Integra has earned my trust, and I’ll definitely use them for my future lawn care needs.
reviews.author: Mark B

reviews.text: Technician Cristian did it again! Excellent weed and feed control treatment with a smile, even when the homeowner is at fault. reviews.text:
Over the past decade (undoubtably much longer), it's become commonplace for businesses big and small to request their customers to post positive reviews of their customers experience. The purpose of which of course is to encourage the consumer looking for whatever kind of business or service to check out the online feedback of satisfied (and not so satisfied) client or customer.
In my case, I don't know what more I can say in a complimentary manner about the same company. The fact that I've been utilizing   the lawn maintenance company (the Integra Pest & Lawn) for 15 or 16 straight years should speak volumes! If I wasn't happy and quite satisfied with Mr. Jeremy Guevara (the owner), of Integra Pest & Lawn and his dedicated, hard-working lawn techs, I would have turned to one of their lawn maintenance competitors many years ago.
well, I guess that's about all I have to say. Reader, I do thank you for your time. Take care.
Yours respectfully,
Philip W. R

reviews.text: I waited a few days to ensure this review was based on truth and not anger.  We used Integra for about 2 years.  In that time frame they did reduce our weeds (never completely) and they were good about keeping their appointments or letting us know when they could not make it.  They did have to come back a few times because the grass was left uneven or patchy, but overall, it was ok.  The reason we recently stopped their service was due to their billing department.  Our account was charged over $160 with no call ahead of time to give us a heads up or to explain why; it was simply charged without warning.  When I called their office, they explained that they were cleaning out accounts and it was backpay from June, July and August.  Our account was on auto pay and never showed a past due balance in the customer portal.  When I submitted my bank statements to show the payments made for those months, they emailed me back and stated those payments were for invoices previous to that.  They took no responsibility for their billing error and simply put the load on the customer.  I can only assume this was a year end audit and the same scenario happened to other customers - a few days after Christmas and right before most people’s bills are due for the following month.  I highly recommend avoiding auto pay with them, keeping track of the dates they do the work, charges and receipts if you still chose to use their services.  Also, ensure they don’t automatically put your card on auto pay without your consent.  This was our case a few months after we started using them, but I made the mistake of not making a big deal of it because of the convenience.
reviews.author: Edith Alvarado

reviews.text: Cristian is fantastic, we love his energy! Very prompt and empathetic. We appreciate his service, and would absolutely recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Tommy Olguin

reviews.text: Great lawn and pest control service!
reviews.author: Juan Hernandes

reviews.text: Very professional and very helpful when I have questions! Our yard always looks great after it's been done! Amazing work for an awesome price!
reviews.author: Michele Wilson

reviews.text: Love the personal service! Our tech is knowledgeable and cares about our lawn, which is a cut above the rest.
reviews.author: John Ingebritson

reviews.text: Best lawn service I have used. Guys always go above and beyond. Maim office is responsive and always reminds me when they are showing up. Lawn always looks great when they are done.
reviews.author: Kirk Schutz

reviews.text: Great work, fast service. Lots of compliments from our neighbors. It makes me happy to drive up to my home and see how much better it looks!
reviews.author: Sandy Emerson

reviews.text: They do a great job on my lawn, it looks great. All my friends complement me on my lawn.
reviews.author: David Thompson

reviews.text: Jeremy and the folks at Integra Lawns are the best! They take good care of me and have for several years now. I’m very thankful for them.
reviews.author: Julie Keller

reviews.text: If you want your lawn looking good and maintained, give Integra Pest and Lawn a call! You will not be disappointed! Great, professional service.  Give Jeremy a call. 😊
reviews.author: Tammy Harris

reviews.text:
Love this company they helped turn my sad looking back yard with no grass info a beautiful yard I can be happy to go outside and walk on.
They will bring your yard back to life highly recommend
